snippet.title: [Echoes of the Architects] Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Echoes of the Architects launches July 25 on Steam and joins Tacticon with a free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136490/Echoes_of_the_Architects/?utm_source=gfx47_youtube&utm_term=free_demo&utm_campaign=tacticon&utm_content=commented_gameplay_trailer

Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where creativity drives victory. Design modular, programmable units to build your perfect army. Adapt and outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes that reward tactical precision, ingenuity, and strategic mastery.

🛠️ Modular units to craft your own army
⚙️ Customizable behaviors to implement unique strategies (and skip micro)
⚔️ Dynamic fast-paced battles that reward tactical adaptation

Some useful links:
🎮 Steam Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136490/Echoes_of_the_Architects/?utm_source=gfx47_youtube&utm_term=steam_demo&utm_campaign=tacticon&utm_content=commented_gameplay_trailer
📜 Press Kit: https://presskit.echoes-of-the-architects.com/
📧 Contact: contact@gfx47.com

Voice-over by Jake Parr (https://www.jakeparrthevoice.co.uk/)
